steps.text: Pick File:Onion.png 5 onions from behind Farmer Fred's house.

steps.text: File:Spade.png Run to the north of Draynor Jail, dig for X Marks the Spot (brown patch of four tiles north, one tile east of the bush)

steps.title: Talk to Morgan to start Vampyre …
steps.text: Talk to Morgan to start Vampyre Slayer

steps.text: Go upstairs in Morgan's house

steps.title: take a File:Garlic.png garlic from his …
steps.text: take a File:Garlic.png garlic from his cabinet.

steps.text: File:Bank_icon.png Bank at Draynor bank. — Deposit: File:Onion.png 4 onions, File:Garlic.png garlic. — Withdraw: All coins, bronze pickaxe, bucket, letter — {{Inventory |Bronze_pickaxe |Message_(Romeo_%26_Juliet) |Bucket |Coins\2044 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | |Treasure scroll |Onion |Spade }}

steps.title: Head into Draynor Market. — Optional …
steps.text: Head into Draynor Market. — Optional for safety: Buy up to File:Jug_of_wine.png 5 wines from Fortunato. High level speedrunners take 2 total in a run. — Buy: File:Teleport_card.png 7 chronicle cards and a File:Chronicle.png chronicle from Diango. — Money here is tight, so buy 2 cards, then buy the chronicle, then buy 5 cards. — If you accidentally spend a bit too much, you can just buy fewer of each rune later, or sell a few water runes to the general store.

steps.title: File:Spade.png Dig in the Draynor pig …
steps.text: File:Spade.png Dig in the Draynor pig pen for X Marks the Spot.

steps.title: Grab a File:Cabbage.png Cabbage from the …
steps.text: Grab a File:Cabbage.png Cabbage from the field northwest of the pig pen.

steps.title: Run south to the Port Sarim …
steps.text: Run south to the Port Sarim docks, Talk to Redbeard Frank to start Pirate's Treasure.

steps.title: Talk to Veos to finish X …
steps.text: Talk to Veos to finish X Marks the Spot

steps.title: use the rewarded lamp on Magic.
steps.text: use the rewarded lamp on Magic.

steps.title: File:Transportation_icon.png Take the boat to Karamja …
steps.text: File:Transportation_icon.png Take the boat to Karamja by talking to either Seaman Lorris, Captain Tobias, or Seaman Thresnor. — File:Tap-to-drop_mode.png Drop File:Clue_scroll_(beginner).png Clue scroll (beginner) and File:Spade.png spade.

steps.title: Go to Zembo. — Buy: File:Beer.png …
steps.text: Go to Zembo. — Buy: File:Beer.png 3 Beer, File:Karamjan_rum.png 1 Rum, File:Jug_of_wine.png Wine (Wine is optional for safety).

steps.title: Pick 10 bananas from the plantation.
steps.text: Pick 10 bananas from the plantation.

steps.title: Talk to Luthas.
steps.text: Talk to Luthas.

steps.title: Right click and "Fill" the crate …
steps.text: Right click and "Fill" the crate with bananas.

steps.title: Put the rum in the crate.
steps.text: Put the rum in the crate.

steps.title: Talk to Luthas again to get …
steps.text: Talk to Luthas again to get your payment and send the crate.

steps.title: File:Transportation_icon.png Take the boat back to …
steps.text: File:Transportation_icon.png Take the boat back to Port Sarim.

steps.title: Take a File:White_apron.png White apron from …
steps.text: Take a File:White_apron.png White apron from the fishing shop

steps.title: equip it.
steps.text: equip it.

steps.title: Go to Wydin's Food Store. — …
steps.text: Go to Wydin's Food Store. — Buy: File:Pot_of_flour.png 2 pots of flour, File:Raw_beef.png 1 raw beef. — Hop worlds if the flour is out of stock due to bots.

steps.title: Click the door to the back …
steps.text: Click the door to the back room to get in.

steps.title: Take your File:Karamjan_rum.png rum from the …
steps.text: Take your File:Karamjan_rum.png rum from the banana crate.

steps.title: File:Bank_icon.png Use the deposit box by …
steps.text: File:Bank_icon.png Use the deposit box by the Monks of Entrana to deposit all File:Pot_of_flour.png pots of flour, File:Jug_of_wine.png wines, and File:Beer.png beers. — File:Tap-to-drop_mode.png Drop File:White_apron.png white apron.

steps.title: Talk to Redbeard Frank again
steps.text: Talk to Redbeard Frank again

steps.title: trade your rum for a key.
steps.text: trade your rum for a key.

steps.title: Go to Betty's Magic Emporium. — …
steps.text: Go to Betty's Magic Emporium. — Buy: File:Air_rune.png 50 Air runes, File:Mind_rune.png 50 Mind runes, File:Water_rune.png 50 Water runes, File:Eye_of_newt.png Eye of newt — If you plan to buy a beginner staff and backup wines, buy 10 fewer air runes to ensure you have enough coins for later.

steps.title: Enter Rimmington mine from the north. …
steps.text: Enter Rimmington mine from the north. — Mine File:Copper_ore.png copper, File:Clay.png clay, and File:Tin_ore.png tin.

steps.title: Go to Rimmington. — File:Tap-to-drop_mode.png Drop …
steps.text: Go to Rimmington. — File:Tap-to-drop_mode.png Drop the File:Bronze_pickaxe.png bronze pickaxe.

steps.title: Burn your File:Burnt_meat.png meat on the …
steps.text: Burn your File:Burnt_meat.png meat on the range in the north-eastern house (cook it again if it cooks successfully).

steps.title: Fill your File:Bucket_of_water.png bucket in the …
steps.text: Fill your File:Bucket_of_water.png bucket in the sink. — Use it to File:soft_clay.png wet your clay.

steps.title: Talk to Hetty to start Witch's …
steps.text: Talk to Hetty to start Witch's Potion.

steps.title: Kill a rat in the ranging …
steps.text: Kill a rat in the ranging shop with wind strikes

steps.title: pick up its File:Rat%27s_tail.png tail.
steps.text: pick up its File:Rat%27s_tail.png tail.

steps.title: Pick up a File:Logs.png log in …
steps.text: Pick up a File:Logs.png log in the ranging shop.

steps.title: Go back to Hetty
steps.text: Go back to Hetty

steps.text: complete Witch's Potion by talking to her then clicking the cauldron.

steps.text: File:Chronicle.png Chronicle teleport.

steps.title: File:Skull_(status)_icon.png Die to a Dark wizard. …
steps.text: File:Skull_(status)_icon.png Die to a Dark wizard. It is highly recommended to find a Level 20 Dark Wizard, as they will kill you faster. They have an Attack range of 4 tiles, so use that to your advantage.
